description: University Grants Commission - The Institute of Indigenous Medicine (Amendment) Ordinance No. 02 of 2016 and The Gampaha Wickramarachchi Ayurveda Institute (Amendment) Ordinance No. 03 of 2016
categorisation: The gazette content contains ordinances made by the University Grants Commission amending existing university ordinances. This involves legal amendments to the Universities Act and specific institute ordinances, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (new regulations, statutory instruments, and modifications to existing laws).
